purpose: Mystery fiction as a controlled distribution of questions, clues, inferences, and solutions across reader and character viewpoints.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Keep the mystery and its solution specific to a work and edition. Distinguish literary clue logic from real forensic reliability and documented authorship from later lore.
